request: Create an APB register block with four 32-bit registers.
expected_behavior: RTL for module apb_regs (APB4, ADDR_WIDTH 8, DATA_WIDTH 32, zero wait states) with four registers at 0x0 to 0xC, and a self-checking testbench, following the approved interface specification and microarchitecture, gated by lint, simulation, and synthesis (and formal, when a .sby is written) before review.
constraints: Work only from the approved interface specification and microarchitecture.
Lint-clean under Verilator -Wall with no waivers.
known_failure_modes: Unmapped addresses (misaligned, or 0x10 and above) answered without PSLVERR, or a write to them changing a register.
pstrb ignored or applied to the wrong byte lanes.
A write taking effect in the setup phase, invisible at the ports to a weak testbench.
A self-written testbench too weak to notice the above; the held-out reference testbench judges instead.

held_out.name: The reference testbench passes on the seat's RTL
